findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 552b4ec57f53c5d79c2011a9cd78fd43bee53edb2af2654966810618d24a72e1; all 5 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.
Claims are bounded to five official sources: current Martin CAD home search, a no-query Search Results response, Data and Records routing, and two current Texas Comptroller context and routing pages.
The exact home response is 286,695 bytes with SHA-256 40762c8f711aae3d69b28f9cefaedfd9baba424b89671f2b09abb2c2ec84bb9a.
The exact no-query Search Results response is 113,445 bytes with SHA-256 61b5cccd322f6fbcb7e39fed14fd7f6187cc2baee557b3d271de4a1a88dda2e4.
The exact Data and Records response is 85,639 bytes with SHA-256 10b1c8c4e00610e91abaef690f59728fdc5668d87da8b909c603e7bdf654a3fb.

The Texas Comptroller valuing and county-directory responses are 134,841 and 138,875 bytes with SHA-256 values f8a36293f7b7d40a74d1116ff2dfe9e96a3d2e02a944f7955a43ab741f6f604d and b302ecd7f4728adcbeb4d2440645d16906f74fd30cceac84f3e653c69655dd86.

No query was submitted, the table body was empty, no Agent option values were reproduced, and no owner, agent, address, property, account, or lease record was reviewed or reproduced.

sources_inspected.label: Martin CAD public property-search home page (accessed 2026-08-29)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current public advanced property-search form supplies exact search-input labels and the Mineral property-type option.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: Field presence does not validate an entered term, result, ownership, title, agency, lease, value, tax, production, royalty, transaction, or legal conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Martin CAD Search Results page without a query (accessed 2026-08-29)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The no-query Search Results page supplies the Mineral Property filter, visible-column labels, empty table headers, and the Owner Address versus Address label boundary.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: No query was submitted, no result was returned, and no record or underlying data was validated.

sources_inspected.label: Martin CAD Data and Records page (accessed 2026-08-29)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official Data and Records page separately routes readers to reports, plans, and certified mineral-roll downloads.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: A dataset link does not validate a search hit, ownership, title, lease status, appraisal, tax, sale value, or transaction result.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller Valuing Property page (accessed 2026-08-29)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Texas Comptroller page supplies current general appraisal-district and mass-appraisal context.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: Statewide context does not establish mineral title, lease validity, a Martin search result, or a sale value.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller Local Property Appraisal and Tax Information directory (accessed 2026-08-29)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Texas Comptroller county directory routes current local appraisal and property-tax questions to the applicable office.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The directory does not verify a record, ownership, agency, title, value, tax liability, or transaction result.
